body.objective: Publish and validate the executable Djimit ecosystem activation plan and typed goal batch.
acceptance_criteria: Plan defines four bounded loops and nine ordered goals
Goal batch preview validates every item with zero writes
falsification_tests: Preview mutates state or accepts an invalid dependency

body.objective: Restore trustworthy per-client rate limiting behind nginx without trusting direct Tailscale peers or public addresses.
acceptance_criteria: Private reverse-proxy hops are trusted
Direct CGNAT and public addresses are not trusted
Live nginx requests emit no forwarded-for validation error
falsification_tests: An untrusted peer can choose req.ip through X-Forwarded-For

body.objective: Canonicalize reviewed OpenMythos and DjimitFlo source and deploy only the resulting attested main artifact.
acceptance_criteria: Independent reviews and required checks pass
OpenMythos merges before DjimitFlo
Live commit, digest, database and rollback evidence match canonical source
falsification_tests: Runtime identity differs from canonical source

body.objective: Close three bounded operational pilots covering success, deliberate denial and failure recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Each pilot has a distinct correlation and complete evidence lineage
Maker, checker and protected approval separation remains intact
Success, denial and recovery are visible on the Interaction Board
falsification_tests: A failure is reclassified as success

body.objective: Prove the four-link OpenMythos and WorldLab assurance spine with replayable success and denial evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Four prioritized contracts are OBSERVED
Every trace contains actor, correlation, status, scope and evidence references
Unexercised contracts remain UNDETERMINED
falsification_tests: A declared contract becomes OBSERVED without a matching interaction

body.objective: Convert one qualified curiosity opportunity into a bounded Paperclip-ready protocol and prove live runtime execution identity.
acceptance_criteria: At most one task exports per planning cycle
Protocol includes question, null, falsification, budget and reversibility
Maker, checker and challenger runtime evidence is observed
falsification_tests: A dream opportunity directly executes or more than one exports per cycle

body.objective: Run a preregistered 2x2 provenance and checker-independence WorldLab campaign after challenge calibration.
acceptance_criteria: Control is calibrated away from floor and ceiling
At least 30 valid paired replications per confirmatory cell
Condition vectors, confidence intervals and falsification status are packaged
constraints: no world score or causal overclaim
falsification_tests: Model or artifact identity is missing

body.objective: Reach a governed retain, reject or promotion-candidate decision for one existing skill using complete operational attribution.
acceptance_criteria: Skill id, version, hash, task, model, runtime, baseline, metric, cost and causal status are present
Independent holdout evidence supports the decision
Promotion remains human-gated

body.objective: Publish an independently checkable activation status matrix after repository, runtime, browser and assurance validation.
acceptance_criteria: All claims use explicit evidence states
Regression, security, mutation, replay, corpus and browser checks are recorded
Remaining authority gates and removal paths are explicit
falsification_tests: A health response or passing CI is presented as complete integration proof
